content: Darunavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4, which is involved in its metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dasatinib increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or effect of dasatinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Deferasirox reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dexamethasone decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Similarly, etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or effect of dexamethasone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA), an herbal supplement, increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of diazepam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of buccal diazepam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism but increases its levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Strong or moderate CYP2C19 inhibitors may slow the elimination of diazepam, increasing the risk of adverse effects. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of intranasal diazepam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism but increases its levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine increases digoxin levels by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. This may lead to increased toxicity. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Diltiazem increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or effect of diltiazem by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Disulfiram increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of doxorubicin and liposomal doxorubicin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of dronabinol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Dronedarone increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Efavirenz increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism but decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Elagolix increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Elagolix is a weak CYP2C19 inhibitor. Conversely, etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or effect of elagolix by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix also decreases etravirine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of eletriptan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Encorafenib affects CYP3A4 metabolism by both inhibiting and inducing it at clinically relevant plasma concentrations. Co-administration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may increase toxicity or reduce efficacy. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of erlotinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of escitalopram by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism but decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Eslicarbazepine acetate increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism but decreases its levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Esomeprazole increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine increases esomeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of estradiol, estradiol vaginal, conjugated synthetic estrogens, esterified estrogens, and estropipate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced, and nonhormonal contraceptive methods are recommended. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of eszopiclone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ethinylestradiol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Hormonal contraceptive efficacy may be reduced, and nonhormonal contraceptive methods are recommended. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ethosuximide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of ethotoin by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etonogestrel by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etoposide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of exemestane by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fedratinib increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 metabolism. Dose adjustments for CYP2C19 substrates may be necessary. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Felbamate increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine reduces felbamate levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Felodipine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine reduces felodipine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of fesoterodine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fexinidazole increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of flibanserin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly decrease flibanserin systemic exposure. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fluconazole increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C19, CYP2C9/10, and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Fludrocortisone decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine reduces fludrocortisone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fluoxetine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of flurazepam by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fluvoxamine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Fosamprenavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fosaprepitant increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine reduces fosaprepitant levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of fosphenytoin by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Conversely, fosphenytoin reduces etravirine levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of gefitinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. If co-administered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer, increase gefitinib to 500 mg daily and resume the standard dose of 250 mg/day seven days after discontinuing the inducer. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with CYP3A4 inducers may decrease glecaprevir/pibrentasvir plasma concentrations. Etravirine also increases glecaprevir/pibrentasvir levels by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution and monitoring are advised. Grapefruit increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Griseofulvin decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of guanfacine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce guanfacine plasma concentrations and elimination half-life. For ADHD patients, doubling the recommended dose of guanfacine may be considered. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of haloperidol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of hydrocodone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Caution is advised when discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers co-administered with hydrocodone, as plasma concentrations may increase, potentially leading to fatal respiratory depression. Hydrocortisone decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Conversely, etravirine reduces hydrocortisone levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine increases the toxicity of ifosfamide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. CYP3A4 inducers may increase the metabolism of ifosfamide to its active alkylating metabolites and the formation of the neurotoxic/nephrotoxic metabolite chloroacetaldehyde. Close monitoring for toxicities and dose adjustment are recommended. Etravirine decreases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of iloperidone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Iloperidone increases etravirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Iloperidone is a time-dependent CYP3A inhibitor and may increase plasma levels of drugs predominantly eliminated by CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. Imatinib increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Etravirine increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of imipramine by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Indinavir increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Isoniazid increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Etravirine reduces the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of isosorbide dinitrate and isosorbide mononitrate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Istradefylline increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Istradefylline 40 mg/day increased peak levels and AUC of CYP3A4 substrates in clinical trials, but this effect was not observed with 20 mg/day. Dose reduction of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates should be considered. Itraconazole increases the plasma concentration or pharmacological effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Dose adjustments for itraconazole, ketoconazole, or posaconazole may be necessary.
